go_gate.coverage_rule: A4 held-out map-mean success must be no lower than RRT restart
go_gate.quality_rule: paired map-mean relative reduction >=5%, hierarchical 95% CI lower >0
go_gate.safety_rule: zero accepted invalid paths; any safety error blocks decision until reviewed
go_gate.insufficient_evidence: Pivot recommendation with explicit uncertainty, not proof of universal inferiority

restart_rule: first attempt uses root planning seed; later seeds use SeedSequence([root_seed, attempt_index]); no result-based selection
postprocessing_policy: identical interruptible greedy shortcut for every candidate; validation and shortcut consume the same global 30s budget, no free extra postprocessing allowance
measurement_policy: fresh serial single-core workers, thread limits1; no per-ray or per-node event files in formal timing
resource_guard: 30s planning plus45s startup/output allowance; stop on worker errors or invalid accepted paths; record workload, memory, elapsed overshoot; never exclude a seed due to poor performance
